title: Wire up compute debug dispatch to write HDR (particles_debug_pattern.hlsl)
motivation: The debug pattern HLSL exists and compiles to DXIL, but the runtime never dispatches it. Implement a minimal compute pipeline to execute the shader and write HDR, proving compute path and descriptor plumbing.
deliverables: Create a small descriptor heap or use root descriptors consistent with the shader
Add UAV barrier for HDR before Composite
Animated color pattern appears (plus simple particle influence)
acceptance: Visible pattern when DXR is disabled or failing
PIX shows a compute Dispatch with the debug shader and UAV writes to HDR
No InfoQueue errors about incompatible root parameter types
implementation: Load the compiled DXIL blob with FileLoader into a blob
Use CreateComputePipelineState with CS bytecode to create m_debugPipelineState
In Particles::WriteDebugPattern(), replace TODO with: bind root sig, set PSO, bind CBV/ SRV/ UAV, dispatch
In App, ensure particles buffer has SRV created if shader expects SRV(t0), or adjust shader/registers to match runtime bindings
notes: Keep it minimal: no descriptor tables are required if root SRV/UAV are used
If using descriptor tables, ensure a shader-visible heap is set on the command list
test_plan: Run Debug build; observe non-black output
In PIX, verify Dispatch threadgroup counts and UAV writes
Toggle to a flat color to validate end-to-end control
